visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back into a bun, wearing a light grey knit V-neck cardigan and a silver necklace with a round pendant, speaks directly to the camera in a room. She gestures with her hands as she discusses a celebrity's look. The background features a large TV screen and some neutral-colored shelving with decorative items. (2) Several static reference photos of the Korean celebrity Karina are displayed on the screen. The photos show her in various settings—a car and an indoor space—focusing on her makeup styles which feature radiant skin and prominent under-eye blush. (3) The woman returns to the frame and introduces a white square-shaped cushion compact from the brand CLIO. She holds the product close to the lens to show its glossy, translucent white packaging. (4) A close-up shot follows, showing the woman applying the cushion foundation to her right cheek using a teardrop-shaped puff. The screen is split into "After" and "Before" sides to demonstrate the foundation's coverage and finish on her skin. (5) The presenter continues to demonstrate the product, turning her face to show the dewy yet satin finish of the foundation under bright indoor lighting. She then transitions to discussing blush, holding up a silver square compact containing a pink cream-like blush product. (6) She applies the pink blush high on her cheekbones, just under her eyes, mimicking the celebrity style she discussed earlier. She uses her fingers to blend the product into her skin. (7) Three swatches of different blush shades are shown on her inner forearm, labeled with text. She then applies the same pink product to her lips. The video ends with her posing and smiling, showing the completed makeup look.
